payload.answer: The scheduling failure for proofix-case-04/reports-worker was caused by a nodeSelector mismatch (pod selected disk=nvme and storage=nvme while the intended node node1 only had storage=nvme) and a missing toleration for the taint dedicated=reports:NoSchedule on node1. The deployment was patched to select storage=nvme and tolerate dedicated=reports:NoSchedule with effect NoSchedule, successfully completing the rollout.
